desc: Identify the divisibility-level approach: start with the total of all pair sums and subtract appropriately scaled totals over pairs divisible by powers of two.

Derive a complete formula for the total contribution at one modulus \(m=2^k\), using residue frequencies and value sums, with a proof that unordered pairs \(i\le j\) and diagonal pairs are counted exactly once.
Establish the exact odd-part identity and maximum required power-of-two level.
Design an \(O(N\log M)\) implementation that builds residue aggregates efficiently for each modulus.
Establish integer bounds and implement the algorithm in Python with stdin/stdout handling.
